system.description:
Granted for free the moment a character takes the Archivist class. Open this item's own sheet to see the book grow — six PP 2 Divinity spells at 1st level, two more every level after — and to add spells to it as slots open up. Being in the book is not the same as knowing it for the day: memorise from it at daily preparation (the Magic tab's Memorisation card) before a spell in it can be cast, or Recite from the Text to reach one in the moment.

The book may hold prayers of religions other than your own; recording a prayer is not accepting it. Specialist spells cannot be learned by copying them in.
